task.description: Implement the validated design fixing ISS-0184 C3: TC-ES-03-01 leaks 3 heap allocations because first.record and second.record are never deinit()d.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration-svc leak count decreases by exactly 3

result.summary: Implemented per design with one necessary deviation, verified empirically before committing: the design's illustrative code kept first/second as const, but EventRecord.deinit(self: *EventRecord, ...) requires a mutable pointer -- confirmed via a standalone Zig compile test that const bindings cannot call it (compile error: expected *T, found *const T). Changed first/second to var and used first.record.deinit(alloc) / second.record.deinit(alloc) (not direct alloc.free() calls on the fields, which was an earlier draft I discarded after checking duplicateFromParams() -- store.zig:1210-1224 -- returns EventRecord with event_type/payload/metadata as literal empty-string constants on its fallback path, not heap-allocated; a direct free() would be a bug on that path, whereas .deinit() already guards with if (self.field.len > 0)). zig build: exit 0. zig build test-integration-svc: leak count 52 -> 49 (-3, exactly matching the 3 leaked allocations), TC-ES-03-01 not present in any failure/leak output (passes clean). tools/lint_sql_param_types.py: 0/0/0. Only tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig modified.
